uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7841.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7396-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7396-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

813-2320-3647.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Displace.
813-2320-3647.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and putting Displace into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Displace to your hand.
Repeat.

69-539-2085-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2085-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2085-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1012-3899-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-3899-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

413-2738-4871-5075.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

121-553-819.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Hypersonic Dragon.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4324-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4324-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4518-5870-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
4399-4518-5870-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

856-4050-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4050-4321-7422.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2034-3490-6097-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6097-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

178-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
178-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

539-4552-4893-7251.description:
Activate Vindictive Warden by paying {0} due to Training Grounds and Blossoming Tortoise (as Vindictive Warden is a land due to Ashaya), dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Aang

1525-2719-6986-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
1525-2719-6986-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Leyline of Mutation and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
1525-2719-6986-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-4359.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

457-1329-3338-6259-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Samut.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-7060.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

339-677-5686-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-2459-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2438-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2438-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1580-2060-2511-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-2511-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

225-703-5702.manaNeeded: {1} if the land card in hand does not enter untapped and/or cannot produce mana
225-703-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand. 
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, or the land card in hand can tap to produce {G}.
225-703-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, if the land enters the battlefield untapped, activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Astral Dragon.
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of a land you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger twice.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 two additional times for the Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers from step 8.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat from step 6 with the second Springheart Nantuko trigger.

1445-2279-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-5231.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3017-4052-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
3017-4052-6264.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

1657-2595.notablePrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
1657-2595.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 3.

1817-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-5315-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1110-2034-3490-4016.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1110-2034-3490-4016.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 1 damage to Snapping Sailback.
Snapping Sailback triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Snapping Sailback trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servo tokens.

1379-2034-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pincher, adding {C}{C}.
The Pincher dies, triggering Summoning Station, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2034-2308-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5070.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1506-1651-3888.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
486-1506-1651-3888.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Olivia's Attendants to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Blood tokens, untapping Olviia's Attendants.
Repeat from step 2.
